s2.ptxt: Slide the front seat cushion shield LWR LH in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration, and install it by engaging the claws.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Seat Cushion Shield Lower RH

s2.ptxt: Slide the front seat cushion shield LWR RH in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration, and install it by engaging the claws.

s-1.ptxt: Install Reclining Adjuster Inside Cover LH

s2.ptxt: Install the reclining adjuster inside cover LH with the screw.

s2.ptxt: Insert the guide.

s-1.ptxt: Install Reclining Adjuster Inside Cover RH

s2.ptxt: Install the reclining adjuster inside cover RH with the screw.

Install the reclining adjuster inside cover LH with the screw.
Install the clamp.

s-1.ptxt: Install Separate Type Front Seatback Cover RH

item.ptxt: If the separate type front seatback cover RH of a vehicle with side airbags is torn or frayed, the side airbag may not deploy properly, so replace it with a new separate type front seatback cover RH.
If the separate type front seatback cover RH of a vehicle with side airbags is not installed securely, the side airbag may not deploy properly, so strictly observe the following procedures.

s2.ptxt: Using hog ring pliers, install the separate type front seatback cover RH with 8 new hog rings.

item.ptxt: Do not soil or damage the separate type front seatback cover RH.
Align the center of the suspension fabric with the center of the separate type front seatback pad RH so that no wrinkles occur, and install the hog rings.

atten4.ptxt: If the pull-in wire is not attached when replacing the separate type front seatback cover RH, reuse the pull-in wire.

s-1.ptxt: Install Separate Type Front Seatback Cover w/ Pad

s2.ptxt: Temporarily install the separate type front seatback cover with pad to the front seat frame & adjuster RH.
Engage the 4 claws to install the 2 front seat headrest supports.

item.ptxt: Check that the 4 claws are securely engaged.

s2.ptxt: Install the bracket of the separate type front seatback cover RH with the nut.

item.ptxt: When installing the bracket, check that the band is not twisted.
Install the bracket so that it wraps around the side airbag.
If the bracket is not installed securely, the side airbag may not deploy properly.

s2.ptxt: Using hog ring pliers, install 4 new hog rings.
Using hog ring pliers, install the separate type front seatback cover RH with 3 new hog rings.

s-1.ptxt: Install Separate Type Front Seat Cushion Cover RH

s2.ptxt: Using hog ring pliers, install the separate type front seat cushion cover RH with 12 new hog rings.

item.ptxt: Do not soil or damage the separate type front seat cushion cover RH.
Align the center of the suspension fabric with the center of the separate type front seat cushion pad RH so that no wrinkles occur, and install the hog rings.

atten4.ptxt: If the pull-in wire is not attached when replacing the separate type front seat cushion cover RH, reuse the pull-in wire.

s-1.ptxt: Install Separate Type Front Seat Cushion Cover w/ Pad

s2.ptxt: Temporarily install the separate type front seat cushion cover with pad to the front seat frame & adjuster RH.
Attach each J-hook.
Install the separate type front seat cushion cover with pad with the 3 J-hooks and 2 clips.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Seat Cushion Shield Inner RH

s2.ptxt: Slide the front seat cushion shield INN RH in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration, and insert the guide into the clip.
Engage the claws from the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration, and install the front seat cushion shield INN RH.
Install the screw.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Seat Inner Belt Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Install the front seat inner belt assembly RH with the nut.

atten3.ptxt: Install the front seat inner belt assembly RH so that it does not ride up on the locator.

s2.ptxt: Engage each clamp and connect the connector.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Seat Cushion Shield RH

s2.ptxt: Insert the 2 guides.
Engage the claws.
Install the front seat cushion shield RH with the 2 screws.
Install the vertical adjuster handle RH with the 2 screws.
Engage the 2 claws and install the vertical adjuster cover RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Reclining Adjuster Release Handle RH

s2.ptxt: Engage the claws to install the reclining adjuster release handle RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Seat Under Tray (w/ Seat Under Tray)

s2.ptxt: Engage the 2 guides and install the seat under tray. (Front passenger side only)
